name: ai-inventory
description: Scan a repository for the AI systems, model providers and oversight points it actually contains, review the manifest in a PR, and land it in Noru.

interface.shortDescription: Inventory this repository's AI systems, and find the AI disclosures that are missing.
interface.longDescription: Scans a repository for model and provider SDK usage, concrete model ids, agent and prompt definitions, retrieval sources, eval suites and human-oversight points, then produces a reviewable .noru/ai-inventory.yml. Raises EU AI Act Article 5 prohibited-practice signals and Article 50 transparency triggers, and reports whether the disclosure or content marking each trigger requires is actually present in the code. Every claim carries the file:line that produced it and a named owner. Pushes to Noru as assets, vendors and evidence with repository provenance.
capabilities: EU AI Act Article 5 prohibited-practice screening
EU AI Act Article 50 triggers and missing-disclosure detection
Model provider and retention claim provenance
ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF alignment suggestions
Idempotent push to Noru assets, vendors and evidence
interface.defaultPrompt: Scan this repository for AI systems and show me what would land in Noru.
